exposure: neonatal infection status (cases vs. comparison group)
cohort: Neonates weighing > 1500 g or/and ≥ 32 weeks gestation born in 12 public hospitals in Nepal
finding: Antepartum factors, such as antenatal care attendance, and intrapartum factors such as mode of delivery and birth asphyxia, were risk factors for neonatal infections.
mod_finding: Babies born through caesarean section had more than two-fold risk for infection.
